raw_html: [[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Subterfuge|Planar Focus: Subterfuge]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Subterfuge|Planar Focus: Subterfuge]]:''' When this item is equipped at the same time as a [[Planar Conflux]], you will gain True Seeing, a +5 Insight modifier to attack rolls on attacks that would be considered Sneak attacks, a +8 Insight modifier to Damage rolls on attacks that would be considered Sneak attacks, and a +3% bonus to your chance to Dodge enemy attacks.
